name: GitLab
description: Imports the projects of a GitLab group (with subgroups) into the knowledge graph (visibility, default branch, topics, last activity) and lists open issues and merge requests for AI clients. Works with gitlab.com and self-managed GitLab. Settings: url (e.g. https://gitlab.com), group (path, e.g. acme/infra), optional token (personal or group access token with read_api; needed for private projects).

mcpTools.name: gitlab.sync
mcpTools.description: Import the projects of the configured group now.

mcpTools.name: gitlab.open
mcpTools.description: Open issues and merge requests of one project of the configured group.
